539-2034-3821-4679-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-2034-3821-4679-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat

2023-4770-4885-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-1724-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1170-1594-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1594-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2738-4871-5147-6887.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, The Skullspore Nexus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

803-2438-3413.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2239-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Ardent Elementalist.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from exile to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2921-6972-7782.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4017-6823-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-6823-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1157-5639-7070--32.notablePrerequisites: You have one or fewer cards in hand.
1157-5639-7070--32.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the Eldrazi.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the Eldrazi.
Arm-Mounted Anchor's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the Eldrazi from exile by paying {0} due to Eye of Ugin.
Repeat.
1157-5639-7070--32.notes: The chosen Eldrazi must be colorless.

2511-4986-5915--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel
Repeat.
2511-4986-5915--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

891-1258-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1849-2440-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1849-2440-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

2457-4289-4460-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1400-4619-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-4619-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}{R}.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Repeat.

431-851-1308-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1308-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

3593-4359-5231.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Garna, adding {R}.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
3593-4359-5231.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

325-2275-5435-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2275-5435-6282.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

617-890-5640.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Palladium Myr.
Ertha Jo's second ability triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Palladium Myr.
Repeat.

803-1789-3967-5649.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
803-1789-3967-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

56-443-1417-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-443-1417-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-443-1417-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

719-1429-5315-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-5315-5402.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

3995-5168-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Bloom Tender's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1636-3143-5696-6175.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5696-6175.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Territorial Scythecat trigger.
Resolve the Territorial Scythecat trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2060-4565-4929-5652.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

2726-3634-3821-5326.notablePrerequisites:
"Time Lord" or "Rogue" chosen with Reflections of Littjara.
Venser and Peregrine Drake have at least one takeover counter on them.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{B}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
2726-3634-3821-5326.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} and commander tax, if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Master spell.
Resolve the copy of the Master spell, choosing to having the Master token enter the battlefield as a copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the token Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Master spell, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Venser.
When the nontoken Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

989-1931-2882-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Verdant Eidolon.
989-1931-2882-4999.description:
Cast Wild Dogs either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {G}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Verdant Eidolon due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Wild Dogs by paying {G} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
If you cast Wild Dogs from your graveyard, Wild Dogs is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Wild Dogs's cycling ability.
Repeat.

575-3739-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nantuko Vigilante, adding {1}.
When Nantuko Vigilante dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nantuko Vigilante from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Nantuko Vigilante by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nantuko Vigilante's morph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up.
Nantuko Vigilante triggers, targeting any artifact and/or enchantment.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Nantuko Vigilante triggers, destroying any number of artifacts and/or enchantments.

850-2816.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Overgrown Battlement.
850-2816.notablePrerequisites: Overgrown Battlement does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three creatures with defender.
850-2816.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Overgrown Battlement by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4499-4685-4772.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Prosperous Pirates.
Prosperous Pirates enters the battlefield, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

231-661-2119-3390.description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Seat of the Synod.
Activate Sculpting Steel by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {W} and returning Sculpting Steel from the battlefield to your hand.
If it has not triggered this turn, Tameshi's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Tameshi's second ability, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
